    18	 * Custom rule that combines all parameter sets that can be used to resolve

    20	 *
    21	 * Enforces mutual exclusivity between {@see CountryIDsSet} and
    22	 * {@see CountryISOsSet} via {@see OrRule}: callers must provide
    23	 * `countryIDs` **or** `countryISOs`, not both.
    24	 *
    25	 * The {@see addSet()} override ensures only {@see AppCountriesParamSetInterface}
    26	 * instances are accepted, throwing {@see CountryAPIException} otherwise.
    27	 *
    28	 * Mirrors {@see AppCountryParamRule} (singular) for pattern consistency.
    29	 *
    30	 * @package Countries
    31	 * @subpackage API
    32	 *
    33	 * @method AppCountriesParamSetInterface|NULL getValidSet()
    34	 * @method AppCountriesParamSetInterface requireValidSet()
    35	 */
    36	class AppCountriesParamRule extends OrRule
    37	{
    38	    public function __construct(AppCountriesAPIInterface $method)
    39	    {
    40	        parent::__construct('Selecting countries');
    41	
    42	        $this
    43	            ->addSet(new CountryIDsSet($method))
    44	            ->addSet(new CountryISOsSet($method));
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /**
    48	     * Adds a parameter set to the rule.
    49	     *
    50	     * Only {@see AppCountriesParamSetInterface} instances are accepted.
    51	     * Passing any other {@see ParamSetInterface} implementation throws
    52	     * a {@see CountryAPIException}.
    53	     *
    54	     * @param AppCountriesParamSetInterface|ParamSetInterface $set Only {@see AppCountriesParamSetInterface} instances are allowed.
    55	     * @return $this
    56	     * @throws CountryAPIException When $set does not implement {@see AppCountriesParamSetInterface}.
    57	     */
    58	    public function addSet(AppCountriesParamSetInterface|ParamSetInterface $set): self
    59	    {
    60	        if($set instanceof AppCountriesParamSetInterface) {
    61	            return parent::addSet($set);
    62	        }
    63	
    64	        throw new CountryAPIException(
    65	            'Not a countries API parameter set.',
    66	            sprintf(
    67	                'The param set is of type %s, but must implement %s.',
    68	                get_class($set),
    69	                AppCountriesParamSetInterface::class
    70	            ),
    71	            CountryAPIException::INVALID_PARAM_SET
    72	        );
    73	    }

msg.content: 1 2 3 # Application Framework 4 5 All-in-one PHP framework and UI layer for building web and intranet 6 applications. 7 8 ## Introduction 9 10 The framework is designed to be a solid foundation for custom-built web 11 applications. The integrated functionality helps to focus on the application 12 logic, while being able to create the necessary administration screens, 13 APIs and more with minimal effort. 14 15 Note that it is not a CMS: it is exclusively a tool for building custom 16 applications. Supporting features are available out of the box, like the 17 notepad or image library, but anything your application needs to do must 18 be implemented by you. 19 20 One of the core functionalities of the framework is to provide an extensive 21 ecology of classes for accessing custom data stored in the database. 22 This includes complex filtering capabilities as well as a versioning 23 system with record state tracking (draft, published, etc.). 24 25 ## Features overview 26 27 - PHP helper classes for UI elements 28 - Form building system - every screen is a form 29 - Rule-based application environment detection 30 - Advanced database-stored data handling tools 31 - Class-based extensible templating system 32 - Localization system for UI translation 33 - News central (release notes, etc.) 34 - Event handling system 35 - Image media library and UI 36 - Tagging system and UI 37 - Versioning system with state tracking 38 - Disposables system for automated garbage collection 39 - API response caching (file-based, opt-in via Interface + Trait; TTL and manual strategies) 40 - SSO via CAS 41 - Interface Translations: English, German, French 42 - Build-time module documentation generators (Modules Overview, Keyword Glossary) 43 - Own ecology of supporting libraries 44 45 ## Requirements 46 47 - PHP 7.4 or higher (fully PHP 8 compatible) 48 - [Composer](https://getcomposer.org) 49 - MariaDB or MySQL database with InnoDB support 50 - Webserver 51 52 ## Installation 53 54 The framework can be installed as a regular Composer dependency. 55 However, the required application skeleton of folders and files 56 can currently only be generated dynamically using the 57 [Framework Manager][], which is currently still a private project. 58 59 Documentation on how to set up an application using the framework 60 is still in progress. In the meantime, the example application can 61 be used as a reference (see [Example application](#example-application)). 62 63 ## Example application 64 65 The framework includes a sample application which is used as a reference for 66 available features, best practices, and testing. It can also be used as 67 the basis for a new application. 68 69 You will find it in the `tests/application` folder. 70 71 **Installation** 72 73 1. Import the SQL file `tests/sql/testsuite.sql` into a database. 74 2. Open the folder `tests/application/config`. 75 3. Copy `test-db-config.dist.php` to `test-db-config.php`. 76 4. Copy `test-ui-config.dist.php` to `test-ui-config.php`. 77 5. Edit the settings in both files. 78 6. Access the `tests/application` folder via the webserver. 79 80 ## Composer commands 81 82 These are custom Composer commands that are available 83 when developing locally. 84 85 ### Build 86 87 The build step generates module documentation artefacts from `module-context.yaml` 88 files discovered throughout the codebase, updates the CTX `generated-at.txt` 89 timestamp, regenerates the API method index, and rebuilds offline event listeners. 90 91 ```bash 92 composer build 93 ``` 94 95 For the full development build (includes module glossary and keyword index): 96 97 ```bash 98 composer build-dev 99 ```

    17	# Submodule: Countries / API
    18	
    19	## Purpose
    20	
    21	Reusable API infrastructure for exposing country data through API methods.
    22	Provides two complementary trait-based patterns for country parameter handling:
    23	
    24	- **Singular** (`AppCountryAPITrait`) — accepts exactly one country via ID or ISO code, resolving to a single `Application_Countries_Country`.
    25	- **Plural** (`AppCountriesAPITrait`) — accepts one or more countries via a list of IDs or ISO codes, resolving to `Application_Countries_Country[]`.
    26	
    27	Both patterns use the `BaseParamsHandlerContainer` / `BaseParamHandler` architecture and enforce mutual exclusivity between the ID and ISO paths via `OrRule`. Both traits can coexist on the same API method when a method needs to handle both a single country and a list of countries.
    28	
    29	---
    30	
    31	## Key Concepts
    32	
    33	- **`AppCountryAPIInterface`** — Contract for single-country API methods. Declares `PARAM_COUNTRY_ID = 'countryID'` and `PARAM_COUNTRY_ISO = 'countryISO'`. Implementations use `AppCountryAPITrait`.
    34	- **`AppCountryAPITrait`** — Mix-in that lazy-initialises `AppCountryParamsContainer`. Apply to any API method that needs a single country parameter.
    35	- **`AppCountryParamsContainer`** — Composes the ID handler, ISO handler, and `OrRule` handler. `resolveValue()` / `requireValue()` return a single `Application_Countries_Country`.
    36	- **`AppCountriesAPIInterface`** — Contract for multi-country API methods. Declares `PARAM_COUNTRY_IDS = 'countryIDs'` and `PARAM_COUNTRY_ISOS = 'countryISOs'`. Implementations use `AppCountriesAPITrait`.
    37	- **`AppCountriesAPITrait`** — Mix-in that lazy-initialises `AppCountriesParamsContainer`. Apply to any API method that needs a list of country parameters.
    38	- **`AppCountriesParamsContainer`** — Composes the IDs handler, ISOs handler, and `OrRule` handler. `resolveValue()` returns `Application_Countries_Country[]` (empty array if nothing resolved); `requireValue()` returns `Application_Countries_Country[]` and terminates the request with an error response if no countries can be resolved.

    41	- **`Params/`** — Individual parameter and validation classes for both single-value (ID, ISO) and multi-value (IDs, ISOs) paths. See [`Params/README.md`](Params/README.md).

   118	
   119	## Validation Strategy — Single vs Multi-Value Parameters
   120	
   121	Single-value parameters (`AppCountryIDParam`, `AppCountryISOParam`) use
   122	`validateByValueExistsCallback()` — a one-shot callback that receives the
   123	already-resolved scalar value and returns `true`/`false`.
   124	
   125	Multi-value parameters (`AppCountryIDsParam`, `AppCountryISOsParam`) require a
   126	custom `BaseParamValidation` subclass instead. The reason:
   127	`ValueExistsCallbackValidation` passes the **entire** resolved value (an `int[]`
   128	or `string[]` array) to the callback as a single argument — it does not iterate
   129	per item. A custom class gives the validator control over per-item iteration and
   130	lets it report precisely which IDs or ISO codes are invalid in a single error
   131	message.
   132	
   133	> **Rule of thumb:** Use `validateByValueExistsCallback()` for scalar parameters.
   134	> Use a `BaseParamValidation` subclass when you need per-item validation on a
   135	> list parameter.
   136	
   137	---
   138	
   139	## `requireValue()` Termination Semantics
   140	
   141	Both `BaseParamsHandlerContainer::requireValue()` and `BaseAPIHandler::requireValue()`
   142	call `->send()` on the error response object when no value can be resolved. The
   143	`->send()` call terminates PHP request execution — no code after the call runs.
   144	
   145	The PHP return type on these base methods is `string|int|float|bool|array|object`
   146	(not `never`) because PHP does not allow `never` on interface/abstract methods that
   147	subclasses override with a narrower non-`never` return type. The
   148	`@phpstan-return never` annotation on each base method makes this contract explicit
   149	for static analysis.
   150	
   151	**Practical implication for subclass overrides:** When a subclass (e.g.
   152	`AppCountriesParamsContainer::requireValue()`) calls `parent::requireValue()` and
   153	then applies a type-narrowing guard (`is_array()` check + fallback `return array()`),
   154	the fallback branch is never reached at runtime — but it is a valid and necessary
   155	guard from PHP's static type perspective, because the parent return type is not
   156	declared `never`. This is the correct pattern for this codebase.

   162	- **Single-country API methods** implement `AppCountryAPIInterface` and use `AppCountryAPITrait` to gain single-country parameter management.
